title: Evaluating a Distance Learning Asthma Education Program for Pediatricians (The DALI Study)
brief_summary: The National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) has established guidelines for treating people with asthma. This study will evaluate the effectiveness of a distance learning program that aims to educate doctors on these guidelines, specifically the use of inhaled corticosteroids to treat asthma in pediatric patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Board-eligible pediatricians involved in direct primary care for children
* Has access to a Windows or Macintosh computer with either a CD-ROM drive or Internet access
* Has access to a telephone for teleconference calls
* Willing to take part in the DALI educational seminar if assigned to the intervention group
